title: An optimal control approach to nonlinear wave speed selection in reaction-diffusion equations
summary: Travelling wave solutions of reaction-diffusion equations are widely used to model the spatial spread of populations and other phenomena in biology and physics. In this article, we reinterpret the classical variational principle approach through an optimal control formulation, in order to obtain a lower bound on the invasion speed of travelling wave solutions in systems of nonlinear partial differential equations.
